title: Ensembly application ledger row (Stage 1)
description: One JSONL line. Append-only: a later row with the same link supersedes earlier ones. Mirrors crates/ensembly-kernel/src/application_ledger.rs.

link.description: Canonical posting URL (identity key; a trailing /application is ignored when matching so older rows are superseded). New rows must not end in /application.

submit_time.description: RFC 3339 with seconds and the Europe/Stockholm offset (+01:00 or +02:00). null for prepared, for withdrawn dropped before sending, or with submit_time_unknown: true.

submit_time_unknown.description: true when the application was sent but its time was never recorded; submit_time is then null. Only for submitted, interview, rejected, silent-closed. Absent otherwise (never false).

cv_version.description: Label of the CV sent. Use the explicit marker "legacy-unknown" for migrated rows whose records never noted the CV; ad-hoc unknown markers are refused (the Rust validator also refuses them case-insensitively).
